events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: John Cleese, a true titan of British comedy, is 87 today! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic double LP, 'The White Album'. Thirty tracks of pure genius – what's your standout?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman and rock icon Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Legend Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: An absolute classic turns another year older! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was unleashed on the world on this day in '65. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon was tragically killed in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who we lost on this day in 1980. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie was born on this day in 1947. He would have turned 80.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the inimitable David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today. A true innovator and Starman.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935. He would have turned 92.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Elvis Presley. The King lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, what's your favourite riff from the guitar god?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rocker and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod The Mod
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Sir Rod Stewart! Raise a glass to the man with the distinctive voice and endless hits.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Icon
angles.copy: It's Suggs' 66th birthday! Wishing the Madness frontman a very happy one. Time to put on some 'Our House', perhaps?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got 'Everytime You Go Away' stuck in your head? So do we.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! From 'Jolene' to '9 to 5', her influence is simply monumental. What's your favourite Dolly track?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! What's your favourite Take That hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Get out your dancing shoes, it's Billy Ocean's 77th birthday! 'Caribbean Queen' or 'When the Going Gets Tough'? So many classics!

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction in 1986
events.blurb: The first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on this day in 1986, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1986, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction! Who was in that legendary first class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Another Take That legend celebrating today. What's your favourite Mark Owen solo moment?

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert in 1969
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles played their iconic rooftop concert – their final public performance! Imagine being on Savile Row that day.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Genesis drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, what's your favourite Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the 'Prince of Pop', Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo stardom, he's given us so many bangers.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved English actor Sir David Jason, known for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure, what's your favourite character he's brought to life?

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash, an event known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: A Tragic Loss
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'. 68 years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in a tragic plane crash.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famous for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up' on his tunes.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley was born on this day in 1945. He would have turned 82.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Bob Marley. His message of 'One Love' lives on.
